question: What holds the two-dimensional embedding of a spectral JEPA with shared positives, and what does not?

provenance.source: Balestriero and LeCun, arXiv:2610.39302v1: Theorem 1 and Proposition 1, objective in its spectral contrastive form (Appendix A.1)
provenance.kind: authored from the equations of the paper; gradient flow of the population objective on a world of four states, written on the three eigenfunctions of the positive-pair operator orthogonal to the constant

name: spectral JEPA, embedding dimension two, shared positives

carrier.name: coefficients (x_i, y_i) of the two embedding coordinates on eigenfunction i of the positive-pair operator

closure: gradient flow of the population objective; the noise of finite batches taken as additive
observable: the embedding of the four world states
assumptions: finite world of four states, uniform marginal, injective rendering
identity predictor, squared distance, second-order anti-collapse term in its soft (spectral contrastive) form
m1 > m2 > m3 are the eigenvalues of the normalized positive-pair kernel below the constant
